· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-0.0035→0.0380) — 개선세 지속, 강세 확산 진단

· 현 구간 진단 (상승추세) — 1.40 진입, 1.30 손절, 1.55 목표
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price($1.40) vs SMA5($1.16)/SMA20($1.06)/SMA50($1.09) — Confirmed above short/mid-term trends.
· Position relative to SMA100($1.15)/SMA200($1.28) — Confirmed mid-to-long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (18.7%) + Current price level is in recovery phase from historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (33.9→83.5) — Confirmed exit from oversold to overbought.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0035→0.0380) — Sustained improvement, diagnosed as bullish expansion.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near upper band $1.26) — Approaching upper band, band width at 37.07% indicates expanding volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($1.38) — Support confirmed based on Pivot S1($1.12) and SMA200($1.28).
· Swing resistance ($1.47) — Potential for further upside upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low + 5-day high renewal) — Strengthening uptrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (3.48x 5-day average) — Increased confidence in movement, strong buying pressure.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend) — Entry at 1.40, stop at 1.30, target at 1.55.
